# Blogs and articles

A blog is an index page with its articles; an article is a page with its own publish state.

[`blog.create`](#blogcreate) · [`article.create`](#articlecreate) · [`blog.update`](#blogupdate) · [`article.update`](#articleupdate) · [`article.publish`](#articlepublish) · [`article.unpublish`](#articleunpublish)

## blog.create

blog.create with entry validation and ownership checks.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | string (min 1, max 200) | yes |
| `slug` | string |  |
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `locale` | string (min 1) |  |

Output: { id: string, slug: string, templateId: string, blogId?: string }

Example input:

```json
{"title":"Journal","templateId":"blog-index-editorial-grid"}
```

## article.create

article.create with entry validation and ownership checks.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | string (min 1, max 200) | yes |
| `slug` | string |  |
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `locale` | string (min 1) |  |
| `blogId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { id: string, slug: string, templateId: string, blogId?: string }

Example input:

```json
{"title":"A house on the hill","templateId":"article-gallery-sticky","blogId":"5f6a7b8c-9d0e-4f1a-8b2c-3d4e5f6a7b8c"}
```

## blog.update

blog.update with entry validation and ownership checks.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `patch` | object | yes |
| `patch.slug` | string |  |
| `patch.title` | Record<string, string> |  |
| `patch.excerpt` | Record<string, string> \| null |  |
| `patch.featuredImageId` | string \| null |  |
| `patch.authorUserId` | string \| null |  |
| `patch.authorName` | string \| null |  |
| `patch.canonicalUrl` | string \| null |  |
| `patch.seo` | { metaTitle?: Record<string, string> \| null, metaDescription?: Record<string, string> \| null, ogImageId?: string \| null, noIndex?: boolean } |  |
| `patch.templateId` | string (min 1) |  |
| `patch.requireAuth` | boolean |  |
| `patch.requiredRoles` | string (max 40)[] (≤50) |  |

Output: { id: string (min 1) }

Example input:

```json
{"id":"5f6a7b8c-9d0e-4f1a-8b2c-3d4e5f6a7b8c","patch":{"title":{"en-US":"Journal"}}}
```

## article.publish

article.publish with entry validation and ownership checks.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `pages`; needs `"confirmed": ["publish"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (min 1) | yes |

Output: { ok: true }

Example input:

```json
{"id":"4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b"}
```
